text:
- A clearer menu: Add comics is now Search, Home's category cards replace the separate Browse page, and the side menu groups Reading and App.
- Make any curated Reading List available offline from its preview. Refreshing keeps the old copy until the new one is checked.
- After Done, a message names the comic you marked read and offers an exact Undo, on the reading screen and in Home's Continue reading. Finishing a section or a whole list is celebrated, and progress shows at a glance.
- Follow a reading path stop by stop on Modern Timeline, which replaces the separate Reading paths page. Old links and bookmarks still open.
- Explore the new VisionQuest MCU Prep guide, fifteen Reading Lists for younger readers on Home's Young readers card, rewritten MCU Prep descriptions and owner-confirmed comics that fill gaps in existing guides.
- Use simpler Reading List cards, dialogs with their buttons always in view, grouped comic actions and clearer backup choices.
- Saved data is unchanged: reading-data schema 4 needs no migration from 4.0.0 or 4.1.0, and backups keep their formats. Builds older than 4.0.0 cannot edit this data or restore its backups, so keep a backup before upgrading from those. Completion history and unfinished imports still need separate exports.
